purpose: Teach: 祖先/生前/独断/戦死/胎児/判別/二酸化炭素/裁定

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、祖先の病歴を医療チームで参照しております
lines.en: Ren, we're reviewing your family's medical history as a team.
lines.style: Even, professional tone. Clear enunciation without coldness. Measured pace that signals care beneath protocol. Direct eye contact level.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 生前の医療意思を、貴院、尊重されておられますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital respects the medical wishes your family expressed, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Quiet intensity. Careful word choice — testing ground, not accusing. Soft pause before 'Doctor.' Respectful but searching.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者さんへの独断的な判断は医療チームでも控えます
lines.en: Yes. We avoid making unilateral decisions about patients — that's a team principle here.
lines.style: Steady reassurance. Slight emphasis on 'team' — not defensive, clarifying. Warm but measured. The voice of someone who's had this conversation before.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 戦死者のご遺族のケアを、貴院、なさってこられましたね、先生
lines.en: And your hospital has been caring for families who've lost people in difficult circumstances?
lines.style: Soft, almost tentative. The question of someone learning something important. Small pause midway, like he's choosing words carefully. Respectful weight on the final phrase.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、胎児の超音波検査を医療チームで丁寧に行います
lines.en: Yes. We conduct prenatal ultrasounds with particular care and attention as a team.
lines.style: Unhurried. Gentle shift in subject — purposeful but not jarring. Emphasis lands on 'particular care.' Voice steady, grounded.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 検査値の判別を、貴院、丁寧にされておられますね、先生
lines.en: The hospital handles test results with real thoughtfulness, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Understated observation. Not quite asking for validation — more like noticing aloud. Small, appreciative quality to the tone. Voice trails slightly, inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、二酸化炭素濃度を病室で監視しております
lines.en: Yes. We monitor CO₂ levels in patient rooms continuously.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but not cold. Clinical detail delivered with the weight of care behind it. Steady tempo. Voice carries the idea that small things, done well, matter.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療裁定が下る前から、貴院、ケアを続けておられますね、先生
lines.en: You continued caring for families even before any medical ruling came down, didn't you?
lines.style: Quietest moment yet. Deep respect underlying every word. Slow pace. Voice soft but not uncertain — the observation of someone moved by what they've witnessed. Trailing fade at the end.
